title: "Z" > "a" is TRUE: text is ordered without regard to case

source.quote: By default, the comparison between strings is case-insensitive and accent-sensitive
source.supports: the default comparison ignores case and respects accents; the page gives "e" and "è" as different

source.quote: The collation defines the ordering of the characters and their equivalence
source.supports: the same collation that makes case irrelevant for equality also defines the sort order

derivation: String comparison is case-insensitive, so "Z" against "a" compares as z against a, and z comes after a: TRUE. By code point the answer would be FALSE (Z is 90, a is 97).
